run_doctest_list_ext: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python list extension functions like new_list and listify
test_append_object_to_list: test appending a single object to a Python list via the Boost.Python append_object extension
test_append_list_to_list: test appending a nested list to another list via the Boost.Python append_list extension
test_listify_tuple_to_list: test converting a tuple to a Python list using the Boost.Python listify function
test_exercise_list_operations: test the exercise function that exercises append, extend, insert, pop, remove, reverse, and sort on lists
